candidats.description: Earthquake damage caused to the Imperial County Services Building in the 1979 Imperial Valley earthquake . The support pillar failed at the east end of the Imperial County Services Building in El Centro . The concrete at the base of the columns was shattered and the vertical reinforced bars were severely bent, allowing the building to sag about 30 cm. This 6-story reinforced concrete frame and shear wall structure, designed to be earthquake resistant, was completed in 1971 at a construction cost of $1.87 million. The building was later destroyed and rebuilt by the County of Imperial . Earthqua

Trump Tower, 725 5th Ave, New York, NY 10022, United States. Trump Tower is a 68-story mixed-use skyscraper located at 725 Fifth Avenue, at the corner of East 56th Street in Midtown Manhattan, New York City. The Trump Tower is the 57th tallest building in New York City. The tower is a reinforced concrete, shear-wall core structure and was the tallest structure of this type in New York City when completed.
